Offer Description

BIOWEG is seeking a Ph.D. candidate for a 36-month fixed-term research position on biopolymer-based seed coatings. You will modify cellulose-based materials and formulate biodegradable seed coatings, with the goal of testing them in greenhouse trials and moving them toward practical application. 

This role is part of AGRIPOLYS Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network dedicated to advancing the development of innovative and sustainable polymeric materials for applications in the agricultural sector. The network aims to address key challenges associated with the performance, sustainability and environmental impact of polymer-based technologies in agriculture, combining advanced polymer chemistry, materials science and application-oriented research.

By integrating cutting-edge research, interdisciplinary doctoral training, international secondments and close collaboration between academic and industrial partners, AGRIPOLYS will train a new generation of researchers equipped to design, develop and evaluate innovative polymer-based solutions for more sustainable agricultural practices. The network provides an international, interdisciplinary and intersectoral doctoral training environment, bridging fundamental research, technological innovation and practical applications.

What We Offer 

  • Funded full-time doctoral position (36 months, fixed-term) within an international, application-oriented research network, including structured doctoral training and individual career development 
  • Competitive remuneration package in accordance with MSCA Doctoral Network rules, including a living allowance adjusted by the applicable country correction coefficient, a mobility allowance and a family allowance (where eligible) 
  • International and interdisciplinary training, including participation in network-wide doctoral training activities, scientific workshops, transferable skills courses and collaborative research events organized by AGRIPOLYS partners 
  • International secondments at academic and/or industrial partner organizations, providing exposure to complementary scientific expertise, advanced research facilities and different research environments 
  • Interdisciplinary supervision and career development, supported by experienced researchers from academic and non-academic institutions, together with an individual career development plan 
  • Scientific and professional development opportunities, including participation in international conferences, publication of research results, networking with academic and industrial experts, and involvement in dissemination, communication, outreach and innovation activities

Additional Information

Eligibility criteria

MANDATORY Eligibility Criteria: 

AGRIPOLYS welcomes applications from highly motivated candidates of any nationality and is committed to equal opportunities in recruitment. 

To be eligible for recruitment as a Doctoral Candidate (DC) within the AGRIPOLYS Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network, applicants must fulfil the following requirements at the date of recruitment: 

Mobility rule: Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Germany for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays, and time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status are not considered. 
 

Academic qualifications: Candidates must hold, or obtain before enrolment, a Master's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant scientific discipline and must not already hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment. Applicants must fulfil the admission requirements of the University of Twente, where they will be enrolled in a doctoral program. 

Selection process

Applicants are invited to apply directly through BIOWEG's careers portal: https://bioweg.jobs.personio.de/job/2877832?_pc=3429848#apply

Please submit the following documents with your application: 

  • Detailed CV outlining academic qualifications and laboratory skills (max. 4 pages) 
  • List of publications (if applicable) 
  • Motivation letter (max. 2 pages) outlining your Master's thesis and the relevance of your previous experience to this position 
  • Copies of academic certificates including final grade and date 
  • Minimum 2 recommendation letters or names and contact details of two referees who may be contacted for a reference
